description: This file implements the DobbyInterface class, which manages container lifecycle operations such as start, stop, pause, resume, hibernate, wakeup, execute commands, and handle container events within a container management system. It interacts with external components like DobbyProxy and OmiProxy to perform IPC and container operations, and it handles event notifications for container state changes.

classes.name: DobbyInterface
classes.description: A class that manages container lifecycle operations and event handling within a container management system, interfacing with external proxies and handling container events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DobbyInterface with an event handler, sets up IPC service, and registers event listeners.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters event listeners, and resets internal state.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of running containers from Dobby and formats it as a JSON string.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a specified container by its ID.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specified container.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a container from an OCI bundle, handling encrypted bundles if necessary.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby-specific specification.

methods.name: stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a specified container, with optional force parameter.

methods.name: pauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses a running container.

methods.name: resumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: hibernateContainer
methods.description: Hibernates a container with specified options.

methods.name: wakeupContainer
methods.description: Wakes up a hibernated container.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: annotate
methods.description: Adds an annotation key-value pair to a container.

methods.name: removeAnnotation
methods.description: Removes an annotation key from a container.

methods.name: mount
methods.description: Mounts a filesystem source to a target inside a container.

methods.name: unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a filesystem target from a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Event handler that signals a container has started.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Event handler that signals a container has stopped.

methods.name: onContainerStateChanged
methods.description: Event handler for container state change events.

methods.name: GetContainerDescriptorFromId
methods.description: Converts a container ID to its internal descriptor.

methods.name: GetContainerIdFromDescriptor
methods.description: Converts an internal descriptor to its container ID.

methods.name: stateListener
methods.description: Callback for container state change events.

methods.name: omiErrorListener
methods.description: Callback for OMI error events.

methods.name: onVerityFailed
methods.description: Handles verification failure for a container, stops the container, and signals failure event.
